description: The project owner's meso drop rule (decision D3-12, docs/ITERATION_LOG.md), applied by the drop runtime (scripts/core/drops/drop_rates.gd DropRates.meso_rule, drop_roller.gd DropRoller). Amount: MeowDB's player report where the canonical drop record has one (data/canonical/drops/<owner id>.json meso.amount_source; today only the Snail, 2 per kill); otherwise a uniform integer in [level x amount_level_multiplier_min, level x amount_level_multiplier_max] of the monster's canonical level (data/canonical/monsters/<id>.json level). When a newer MeowDB capture or cache gains a report for another monster, tools/meowdb/extract_monsters.mjs writes it into that record and the runtime uses it instead of the formula, with no change here. Chance: the same for every monster that drops mesos (MeowDB publishes no meso drop chance). no_mesos lists the owners that never drop mesos.
reason: MeowDB MS Classic has a player meso report for only one Maple Island monster and publishes no meso drop chance, so the project owner approved this rule on 2026-10-06 as a MisoStory adaptation (decision D3-12). It is not a MapleStory fact and is not verified against anything.
chance_reason: 60% per kill for every monster that drops mesos, also for a monster with a MeowDB amount: MeowDB publishes no meso chance (decision D3-12).
